items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And the tango band, which was CANERO, which was the greatest band there they had at the time, CANERO'S band was playing "St. Louis Blues".

ctx.x: Did you start doing any Latin American type music?

Oh, yeah. We used to do tangos. And the funny thing, we'd do a tango sometime, and we got them down pretty good. And the tango band, which was CANERO, which was the greatest band there they had at the time, CANERO'S band was playing "St. Louis Blues".
